decisions.name: GuitarParty
decisions.potential: Chord/lyric songbook source; publisher pricing advertises over15000 songs, a publisher claim rather than independently enumerated coverage.
decisions.primaryEvidence: Current terms limit content use, restrict off-service reproduction/storage and require prior written consent for automated extraction. A personal printing exception does not establish Singbook offline ingestion/export permission.
decisions.decision: Do not probe content or reuse third-party API examples or embedded credentials. Defer until a publisher-supported integration/access agreement and offline/export/attribution contract are established.
remaining: supported current API and auth/rate/retry contract
two independent bounded extraction and app retention canaries

decisions.name: ChordWiki Japan
decisions.potential: Japanese lyric/chord charts with ChordPro editing. Indexed publisher pages report around27000 entries; alias snapshots differ, so no synchronized corpus count or new coverage claim.
decisions.primaryEvidence: Current publisher terms identify JASRAC-managed lyrics as licensed for on-site interactive streaming and exclude download/copy/printing; remaining submitted ChordPro data belongs to contributors. The API section describes YouTube integration rather than a supported external chord/lyric API.
decisions.decision: Do not infer open reuse from wiki naming or ChordPro format. No song page, chart/source endpoint or age-confirmation flow requested. Defer intended app persistence/export until permission and a supported access contract are established.
remaining: per-work and contributor permission for intended use
supported stable content access and limits
two independent extraction and app retention canaries

unqualifiedLeads.name: AmDm
unqualifiedLeads.evidence: Search surfaced a2017 user Q&A asking for an API. This is not current publisher API documentation or proof that no API exists. No guessed route or song page was requested.
unqualifiedLeads.decision: Continue documentation discovery later; do not assert API availability or absence.

unqualifiedLeads.name: Chords.wiki
unqualifiedLeads.evidence: Separate domain from ChordWiki Japan. Search surfaced publisher terms prohibiting scraping and asking developers to request API access. No scope or corpus size established, no outreach made.
unqualifiedLeads.decision: Do not conflate these services or treat one policy as authorization for the other.

nonPrimaryResults: Third-party code, historic API/credential examples and unsolicited PDF search snippets were not used as access authorization, executed, downloaded or reproduced.
